message.name: DRONE_MISSION_COUNT
message.description: GCS mo mot luot nap ke hoach. Pi tra loi bang DRONE_MISSION_REQUEST(0). COUNT moi khi dang nap thi huy luot cu.
message.field: ID ke hoach do GCS cap. Pi khong sinh.
Thoi diem GCS phat lenh, micro giay UNIX UTC. Pi chi ghi log, khong dung de quyet dinh.
Thoi gian tim marker toi da moi diem. 0 = dung mission.yaml.
So diem, 1-16. Ngoai dai -> ERR_COUNT.
So lan thu lai toi da moi diem. 0 = dung mission.yaml.
Ten ke hoach, chi de nguoi doc. CAT CON 20 BYTE, khong bao loi.

Phien ban hop dong cua GCS: MAJOR*10000 + MINOR*100. Pi CAN truong nay de kiem lech MAJOR truoc khi nhan ke hoach (muc 6.2) - DRONE_TELEMETRY.contract_ver chi di chieu Pi -> GCS nen Pi khong co duong nao biet phien ban cua GCS. 0 = GCS cu chua khai, Pi bo qua kiem tra va ghi STATUSTEXT WARN.

message.name: DRONE_MISSION_REQUEST
message.description: Pi hoi mot diem. Het item_timeout_s = 1,0 s khong nhan duoc ITEM thi phat lai CUNG seq, toi da 5 lan roi ACK ERR_TIMEOUT.
message.field: Phai trung mission_id cua luot dang nap.
Thu tu diem dang hoi, tu 0.

message.name: DRONE_MISSION_ITEM
message.description: Mot diem ke hoach. KHONG cho lat/lon/pos_ned: drone khong co GPS, vi tri suy tu expected_marker_id qua tags.yaml (muc 3.1, 8.3).
message.field: Phai trung mission_id cua luot dang nap.
ID AprilTag - NGUON VI TRI DUY NHAT. Phai co trong tags.yaml, khong thi ACK ERR_UNKNOWN_TAG.
Do cao so voi TAG DICH cua diem nay: z_odom = tag_z + alt_m. KHONG phai so voi diem cat canh.
Ban kinh ngang coi la "da toi noi".
Tran toc do ngang tren chang bay toi diem nay, trong khoang (0; 1,9].
Thoi gian giu on dinh tai diem truoc khi lam action.
Thu tu diem, tu 0, lien tuc.
Hanh dong tai diem.

message.name: DRONE_MISSION_ACK
message.description: Ket qua nap. Pi CHI gui sau khi mission_manager_node da phan quyet, khong gui som khi moi nhan du byte.
message.field: ID ke hoach vua nap.
Ma ket qua.
Chuoi ly do do mission_manager_node sinh ra, chuyen thang khong sua. CAT CON 50 BYTE.

message.name: DRONE_TELEMETRY
message.description: Trang thai tong hop, 2 Hz CO DINH ke ca khi khong nguon nao cap nhat - nguon thieu thi ha co hieu luc tuong ung (quy tac R5).
message.field: Dong ho he thong Pi, co the lech neu chua dong bo NTP. Chi de log va sap thu tu; xet do tuoi thi dung thoi diem GCS NHAN.
Ke hoach dang chay. 0 = chua nap.
MAJOR*10000 + MINOR*100. Ban 0.4 = 400. Lech MAJOR -> muc 6.2.
Vi do. Hieu luc theo GLOBAL_POS_VALID (hien luon 0).
Kinh do. Hieu luc theo GLOBAL_POS_VALID (hien luon 0).
Tag dang BAM. MARKER_VALID = 0 thi BO QUA truong, dung doc -1.
Do cao so voi GOC BAN DO TAG, = -z cua LOCAL_POSITION_NED. Khac goc voi alt_m cua DRONE_MISSION_ITEM.
Van toc he NED (N, E, D). NED, KHONG phai FLU - dien sai dau thi GCS hien drone di len khi no dang xuong.
Phan tram pin. Hieu luc theo BATTERY_VALID (hien luon 0).
Dien ap pin. Hieu luc theo BATTERY_VALID.
Co hieu luc du lieu.
Co trang thai.
RSSI modem 4G. Hieu luc theo RSSI_VALID.
Trang thai FSM nhiem vu.
Chi so diem dang lam, tu 0.
Tong so diem cua ke hoach. 0 = chua nap.
So lan da thu lai o diem hien tai.
Trang thai co cau gap.
Su co dang bat. 0 = binh thuong.
Tag dang TIM (khac tag dang bam). -1 = khong tim. Hai so nay khac nhau suot pha MARKER_SEARCH va do la luc nguoi van hanh can nhin nhat.
CRC-32 IEEE cua ban do tag, cong thuc o muc 8.6. Lech -> GCS khoa nap ke hoach.
Toa do N cua "nha" RTH trong khung da neo. Hieu luc theo HOME_VALID.
Toa do E cua "nha" RTH. Hieu luc theo HOME_VALID.

Ket qua chuyen bay GAN NHAT da ket thuc, chot lai qua ca luc ve IDLE. 0 = chua co chuyen nao xong, hoac Pi cu chua khai (R3b). Can truong nay vi mission_state = 9 khong phan biet duoc "xong" voi "bi huy" (muc 11.5 P30).

message.name: DRONE_LINK_STATS
message.description: Suc khoe duong truyen, 0,2 Hz, HAI CHIEU. Bien "duong truyen te" thanh con so: phan biet mat goi / nghen hang doi / sai chu ky. Truong ben phat KHONG DO DUOC thi dien UINT32_MAX (uint16 -> 0xFFFF), khong dien 0 (R3).
message.field: Goi MAVLink hop le da nhan.
Goi mat, suy tu khoang trong cua seq MAVLink (seq tang dan theo tung sysid/compid).
Goi sai CRC.
Goi sai chu ky (khi bat muc 7.6).
Goi da gui.
Goi telemetry bi bo do nghen (muc 5.3).
Do sau hang doi gui hien tai.
Vong khu hoi, do bang TIMESYNC (111).
